description_good_justification: The README opens with what the repository is: reusable workflows and templates that the Plurano repositories call from thin callers instead of each keeping its own copy. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/README.md
interact_justification: The README lists every reusable workflow with its inputs and check names, and the caller templates show how to call one; issues and pull requests are open on the forge and CONTRIBUTING.md describes how to contribute. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/README.md https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/templates
contribution_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md explains the contribution process: run the local gate (make verify-all), follow the rules it checks, and use Conventional Commits; the pull request template repeats the checklist. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/pull_request_template.md
contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md states what a contribution must meet: the gate must pass, functions stay within the HISS limits, public functions get positive, negative and boundary tests, and commits follow Conventional Commits with a Migration footer for breaking changes. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/Makefile
floss_license_justification: The repository is released under the European Union Public Licence 1.2 (EUPL-1.2); every file carries its licence information, checked by reuse lint in the gate. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/LICENSE https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/REUSE.toml
floss_license_osi_justification: EUPL-1.2 is approved by the Open Source Initiative (https://opensource.org/license/eupl-1-2). Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/LICENSE
license_location_justification: The licence text is in the root LICENSE file and in LICENSES/EUPL-1.2.txt. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/LICENSE https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/LICENSES/EUPL-1.2.txt
documentation_basics_justification: The README documents each workflow with its purpose, inputs, check names and outside hosts, the layout of the repository and the local gate; decision records are in docs/adr. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/README.md https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/docs/adr
documentation_interface_justification: The external interface is the set of reusable workflows and actions: the README table gives each one's inputs, defaults and check names, and interface.lock.json records the interface of every workflow and action, checked in the gate. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/README.md https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/interface.lock.json
sites_https_justification: The project site is the GitHub repository, served only over HTTPS. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes
discussion_justification: GitHub issues and pull requests are enabled and public; they are the discussion channel (repository settings, checked 2026-11-05). Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/issues https://github.com/plurano/horistes/pulls
english_justification: Documentation, decision records, code comments and commit messages are written in English. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/README.md https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/docs/adr
maintained_justification: The repository has received commits on 20 days since its first commit on 2026-10-11 (latest push 2026-11-03), and the update bot keeps the pinned actions and tools current. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/commits/main https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/renovate.json
repo_public_justification: The Git repository is public on GitHub (visibility PUBLIC, checked 2026-11-05). Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes
repo_track_justification: Git records every change with its author, date and signature; the main branch ruleset requires signed commits. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/commits/main https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/rulesets/main.json
repo_interim_justification: Every change lands as a pull request on main, so interim versions between releases are in the repository. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
repo_distributed_justification: The project uses Git, a distributed version control system. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes
version_unique_justification: No release has been made yet: the repository has no release and no tag (checked 2026-11-05). Callers pin a full commit SHA, which is unique, but there is no version identifier until the first release. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/releases https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/README.md
version_semver_justification: No version has been published yet (no release, no tag, checked 2026-11-05), so no versioning scheme is in use. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/releases
version_tags_justification: The repository has no tag yet (checked 2026-11-05) because no release has been made. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/tags
release_notes_justification: No release has been made yet (no release, no tag, checked 2026-11-05), so no release notes exist. N/A does not apply: the workflows are meant for reuse across many repositories. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/releases
release_notes_vulns_justification: No release has been made and no vulnerability has been fixed: the repository has no security advisory (GitHub API, checked 2026-11-05). Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/security/advisories https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/SECURITY.md
report_process_justification: Bugs and feature requests are reported as GitHub issues, as SECURITY.md states; issues are enabled. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/issues https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/SECURITY.md
report_tracker_justification: GitHub issues track individual reports. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/issues
report_responses_justification: No bug report from outside the maintainers has been filed: all 5 issues to date were opened by the maintainer or the update bot (GitHub API, checked 2026-11-05). Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/issues?q=is%3Aissue
enhancement_responses_justification: No enhancement request from outside the maintainers has been filed: all 5 issues to date were opened by the maintainer or the update bot (GitHub API, checked 2026-11-05). Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/issues?q=is%3Aissue
report_archive_justification: Issues and pull requests stay public and searchable on GitHub, with their discussion. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/issues?q=is%3Aissue https://github.com/plurano/horistes/pulls?q=is%3Apr
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md describes how to report a vulnerability: the forge's Report a vulnerability action, with the affected version, a reproduction and the impact. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: Private vulnerability reporting is enabled on the repository (GitHub API, checked 2026-11-05), and SECURITY.md points to it. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/security/advisories/new https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability report has been received: the repository has no security advisory (GitHub API, checked 2026-11-05). SECURITY.md commits to a first answer within 14 days. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/SECURITY.md
build_justification: Nothing is built: the product is workflow files and composite actions that are used as they are, and pyproject.toml only configures the test runner. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/pyproject.toml https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/README.md
build_common_tools_justification: Nothing is built: the product is workflow files and composite actions that are used as they are. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/pyproject.toml
build_floss_tools_justification: Nothing is built: the product is workflow files and composite actions that are used as they are. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/pyproject.toml
test_justification: A pytest suite under tests/ checks the workflow tools, the workflows and the templates, with planted-defect fixtures; it runs in the gate. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tests https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/Makefile
test_invocation_justification: The tests run with the standard command python3 -m pytest, and make verify-all runs them with every other check. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/pyproject.toml https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/Makefile
test_most_justification: coverage.py measures line and branch coverage of tools/ on every gate run, and `coverage report` fails the run below fail_under = 94 in pyproject.toml, which tests/test_coverage_floor.py keeps from being lowered. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/pyproject.toml https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/Makefile https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tests/test_coverage_floor.py
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: The gate (make verify-all), the Python 3.12 floor test and the fuzz job run on every pull request, on main and in the merge queue, and are required checks in the main ruleset. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/rulesets/main.json
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires positive, negative and boundary tests for every public function, and the pull request template asks for them. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/pull_request_template.md
tests_are_added_justification: Recent changes ship with tests: 13 of the last 15 commits on main change files under tests/, and the other 2 are dependency updates (git log, checked 2026-11-05). Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/commits/main
tests_documented_added_justification: The test policy is written in CONTRIBUTING.md and repeated as a checklist item in the pull request template. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/pull_request_template.md
warnings_justification: The gate runs ruff (check and format), yamllint, actionlint and zizmor over the tools, tests and workflows. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/Makefile https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/ruff.toml https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.yamllint.yaml
warnings_fixed_justification: Any linter finding fails make verify-all, which is a required check on main, so warnings are fixed before a change lands. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/Makefile https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/rulesets/main.json
warnings_strict_justification: yamllint runs with --strict, ruff runs a wide rule set (E, F, I, N, UP, B, A, C4, T20, SIM) with no ignored rule, and actionlint and zizmor fail on any finding. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/Makefile https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/ruff.toml
know_secure_design_justification: The primary developer knows secure design principles (least privilege, fail-safe defaults, input validation, minimal attack surface) and applies them here: workflows start from empty permissions, outside hosts are listed with an end date, and a call that analyses nothing fails. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/hosts.toml https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/docs/adr https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
know_common_errors_justification: The primary developer knows the common vulnerability classes of this kind of software (workflow injection, unpinned actions, leaked credentials, OWASP Top 10, CWE Top 25) and the methods that counter them; CodeQL, zizmor and gitleaks run on every change. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/zizmor.yml https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
crypto_published_justification: The tools use only published, reviewed algorithms: RS256 (RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 with SHA-256, RFC 7518) to sign the GitHub App JWT, and SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4) to check downloads, artifacts and copied files. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/merge_train.py#L1586-L1615 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/merge_train.py#L1012 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/results.py#L119-L121 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/hook_copy.py#L16-L19 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/stranger.py#L39 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/actions/verified-download/action.yml
crypto_call_justification: The project implements no cryptography itself: the JWT is signed by calling the openssl command line tool, and digests come from Python's hashlib. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/merge_train.py#L1586-L1615 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/merge_train.py#L361-L399 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/merge_train.py#L1012 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/results.py#L119-L121 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/hook_copy.py#L16-L19 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/stranger.py#L39 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/actions/verified-download/action.yml
crypto_floss_justification: Every function that depends on cryptography runs on FLOSS: OpenSSL (Apache-2.0) signs the JWT and CPython's hashlib (PSF licence, backed by OpenSSL) computes the digests. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/merge_train.py#L1586-L1615 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/merge_train.py#L1012 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/results.py#L119-L121 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/hook_copy.py#L16-L19 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/stranger.py#L39 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/actions/verified-download/action.yml
crypto_keylength_justification: The digests are SHA-256 (256 bits); the merge train refuses an app key that is not RSA (PKCS#1 v1.5, RS256) or has under 2048 bits before any call. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/merge_train.py#L361-L421 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tests/test_merge_train.py#L2149-L2334
crypto_working_justification: No broken algorithm or inappropriate cipher mode is used: signing is RS256 and integrity checks are SHA-256; no MD4, MD5, DES, RC4 or Dual_EC_DRBG appears in the code. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/merge_train.py#L1586-L1615 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/merge_train.py#L1012 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/results.py#L119-L121 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/hook_copy.py#L16-L19 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/stranger.py#L39 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/actions/verified-download/action.yml
crypto_weaknesses_justification: The security mechanisms depend only on RS256 and SHA-256. The one SHA-1 call computes git's own blob id to compare a file with the copy GitHub reports; it decides whether a file changed and protects nothing, and git's object format fixes the algorithm. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/merge_train.py#L1053 https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/merge_train.py#L1586-L1615
crypto_pfs_justification: The software implements no key agreement protocol. Its HTTPS calls go through Python's urllib, whose ssl module (OpenSSL) negotiates the session keys. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools
crypto_password_storage_justification: The software authenticates no users and stores no passwords; it only reads forge tokens and an app key from the CI secrets it is given. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools
crypto_random_justification: The software generates no cryptographic keys or nonces: the app key is supplied by the caller and the JWT carries only issued-at, expiry and issuer claims. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools/merge_train.py#L1586-L1615
delivery_mitm_justification: The workflows are delivered from GitHub over HTTPS and callers pin them by full commit SHA; the tools the gate installs are fetched over HTTPS and checked against pinned SHA-256 hashes. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/requirements/tools.txt https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/templates
delivery_unsigned_justification: No hash is fetched over HTTP: every checksum the gate checks is kept in the repository itself (pinned SHA-256 values and hash-pinned requirements). Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/requirements/tools.txt
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No publicly known vulnerability is open: there is no security advisory and no Dependabot alert (GitHub API, checked 2026-11-05), and dependency security updates are enabled. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/security
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No critical vulnerability has been reported (no advisory, no Dependabot alert, checked 2026-11-05); the merge train serves security updates first. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/security https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/workflows/merge-train.yml
no_leaked_credentials_justification: The gate scans every commit of the checkout with gitleaks and refuses allow-list files; GitHub secret scanning and push protection are enabled and report no alert (checked 2026-11-05). Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/workflows/secret-scan.yml
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL analyses the workflows (actions) and the Python tools on every pull request, on main and weekly; ruff and zizmor run in the gate. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/Makefile
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL runs its security queries for actions and Python, and zizmor looks for workflow vulnerabilities such as template injection and unpinned actions. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/zizmor.yml
static_analysis_fixed_justification: No CodeQL alert is open (checked 2026-11-05); the one CodeQL alert to date was dismissed as a false positive. CodeQL is a required check on main. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/security/code-scanning https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/rulesets/main.json
static_analysis_often_justification: CodeQL runs on every pull request, every push to main and weekly; the gate's linters run on every pull request. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/workflows/codeql.yml https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
dynamic_analysis_justification: The SARIF result reader is fuzzed with Atheris (coverage-guided, based on libFuzzer) for 120 seconds on every pull request and on main; the job is a required check. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/fuzz/fuzz_results.py https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/rulesets/main.json
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: The project's code is Python, a memory-safe language; it contains no C, C++ or other memory-unsafe code. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/tools https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/fuzz/fuzz_results.py
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: The test suite runs with assert enabled (no -O), under Python Development Mode (-X dev: runtime debug checks and ResourceWarning on), with the two filters that turn an unclosed resource into a failure; the gate runs it on every pull request (make verify-all in .github/workflows/ci.yml). Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/Makefile https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/pyproject.toml https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: The fuzz job is a required check, so a crash it finds blocks the change; it passes on main (checked 2026-11-05) and no finding is open. Evidence: https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml https://github.com/plurano/horistes/blob/main/.github/rulesets/main.json
